title: US mortgage performance panel (discrete-time hazard)
notes: Discrete-time hazard framing: one row per loan-period (622,489 rows, 50,049 loans under composite key (id,orig_time)), target = default_time IN that period (2.44%/period hazard). Uses the time-varying covariates (dynamic balance/LTV/rate, and macro gdp/uer/hpi) that the origination snapshot excludes, plus origination statics. LEAKAGE CONTROL: the returned groups vector (loan id) MUST be passed to run_pipeline(groups=) so StratifiedGroupKFold keeps every loan's rows inside one fold (threaded through selection, shapley_utils, parsimony, calibration). KNOWN LIMITATION: grouped CV stops entity leakage, not TIME leakage - macro covariates are shared across loans at the same calendar period; a rigorous model would add out-of-time (vintage) validation. Contemporaneous time-varying covariates are a standard discrete-time-hazard design (covariate observed at period start), not leakage.
